misc: Known for bomb drives despite his advanced age.
Finally made his first hole-in-one on May 24th, 2025, after 20 years of trying.
biography: Harri occupies a revered and formidable place in the chronicles of the Hector Trophée, bringing his exceptional talents from the scenic fairways of Hattula Golf to the prestigious pair competition across seven distinct editions. Affectionately known among fellow competitors as the doctor due to his calm, clinical precision under pressure, Harri possesses a vibrant personality characterized by an insatiable appetite for friendly wagers and an infectious, youthful enthusiasm that belies his advanced age.

Remarkably, despite the passing of two decades marked by tireless perseverance on various links, the doctor finally achieved a lifelong ambition on May 24th, 2025, when he carded his very first hole-in-one. This momentous milestone added yet another layer of folklore to a competitor already celebrated for unleashing astonishingly prodigious drives off the tee that regularly leave younger adversaries in a state of sheer disbelief.

Within the grand context of the tournament, Harri has tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on two separate occasions, cementing his legacy among the elite winners of the event. While the individual accolades represented by the Victor Trophy have thus far remained outside his personal collection, his ongoing involvement in the vibrant community surrounding the tournament ensures that his competitive story remains wide open, with admirers eagerly awaiting his next masterclass on the course.
